Consider an \iperpaper{ebm}{energy-based model} with probability
\[
p_{\iperpaper{theta}{\theta}}(x)
= \frac{e^{-\iperpaper{energy}{E_\theta(x)}}}{\iperpaper{partition}{Z_\theta}}.
\]

The parameter $\iperpaper{theta}{\theta}$ is learned from data. The \iperpaper{partition_prose}{partition function} ensures that the density is normalized.

We can train the model by following the gradient $\iperpaper{gradient}{\nabla_\theta \log p_\theta(x)}$.
